findings.title: Deny creates a standing denial, but the native prompt, the queue and the SCR-76 card never say so; 'Denied requests' does not explain what Clear does
findings.evidence: shared/accessWords.ts consentPrompt (no denial line; defaultId 0, cancelId 0); ObligationActs.tsx AccessActs; AgentAccessPanel.tsx PendingCard and the denials section; docs/ux/flows.md:2255 'Denied until cleared in SCR-76'; docs/ux/scenarios.md:3226
findings.fix: Add one localised line (en+ru) to the prompt detail, queue facts and pending card: 'If you deny, Fabric answers this same request "denied" until you clear it under Agent access'. Add one explaining line under Denied requests.

findings.title: The queue result after an Allow whose product did not open says 'allowed' twice and has an ambiguous 'it'
findings.evidence: launch/ObligationActs.tsx:154-156 concatenates access.queue.allowed + access.allowedConnect; i18n/en.ts:878, i18n/ru.ts:318; SCN-132 quotes 'Allowed. Fabric Inbox did not connect: …'
findings.fix: Add a dedicated key (en+ru): 'You allowed {name} to use {product}. {product} did not connect: {problem} Connect it under Settings → Agent access.'

findings.title: The ru first-run sign-in strings use «Исполнитель» against the brand term «агент для кода» on the same step; the en/ru authenticated string has no final period
findings.fix: Replace with «Агент для кода сообщает…», «…в аккаунт агента для кода…»; add the periods

findings.title: The product card's Connect/Try again/Reconnect/Disconnect buttons do not name their product to a screen reader, although SCR-76 says every button names whose it is
findings.fix: Add aria-labels with the visible words first (e.g. 'Reconnect Fabric Inbox') through new en+ru keys, or narrow the screens.md sentence

findings.title: SCR-76 gives no named result after a plain Allow or Deny (the card vanishes), while the queue says 'You allowed X to use Y'
findings.evidence: AgentAccessPanel.tsx:275 (Deny has no after), :276 afterAllow returns null without a problem; compare ObligationActs.tsx:156
findings.fix: Set an info `said` from access.queue.allowed / access.queue.denied after a successful decision

findings.title: The subject of the same-user floor disclosure is an ambiguous pronoun on the consent path
findings.evidence: i18n/en.ts:880 '…on this Mac. It cannot prove…'; i18n/ru.ts:320 '…на этом Mac. Он не может доказать…'
findings.fix: 'Fabric cannot prove which program sent the request…' / «Fabric не может доказать…»

findings.title: Literal ru on the sign-in-required connect failure
findings.fix: «{name} просит войти снова и уже открыл окно входа.»

findings.evidence: start/FirstRun.tsx:184 renders start.executor.auth.note; no non-registry use of first.exec.note in apps/desktop/src or scripts; docs/brand/strings.md:265
